request:
# fix(dx): stop integration specs failing while they delete their repositories

**Treat this request as self-contained**: everything needed is below. Lands before the dependency-boundary and documentation requests of the same tracking issue.

## What

Integration tests pass or fail because of what they check, not because of how they tidy up. Releases are no longer blocked by a tidy-up failure.

## Why

A release of `main` was blocked by a test whose checks did not fail: deleting its temporary repository did. Nothing has been published since, and the same failure has appeared on another branch.

## Context — read this first

jig is a TypeScript CLI. Specs sit beside the code they cover; specs on real git are named `*.integration.spec.ts` and run in the Vitest `integration` project in `vitest.workspace.ts`. That project already isolates git configuration for every spec through `env` (`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null`, `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`). `tests/support/temp-directory.ts` creates each directory and removes it with `rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })` when the test finishes. Read `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/rules/testing-conventions.md` first.

## What was seen

Both on runners with git 2.56.1, each with 215 of 216 tests passing:

| Run | Test in `src/adapters/git/git-workspace.integration.spec.ts` | Error |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 45642245869 (publish, `451ecbb`) | refuses work that rewrites an approved commit and leaves the host branch as it was | `ENOTEMPTY … rmdir '/tmp/jig-repo-…/.git/objects'` |
| 45642801708 (a dependency update) | takes an amended commit when the commit it replaces was not approved yet | the same |

Something writes to `.git/objects` while the directory is being deleted. **Hypothesis, not confirmed:** `git fetch` or `git commit` starts a detached `git maintenance run --auto`, which outlives the command that started it.

## Target

1. Reproduce the failure with git 2.56 or newer, or show with a git trace (`GIT_TRACE2_EVENT`) which process is still running when the deletion starts. An older local git may never show it.
2. Stop that cause for every integration spec, in the one place that already isolates their git configuration. If background maintenance is the cause, disable it there.
3. Keep the hypothesis a hypothesis until that evidence exists. If the cause is something else, such as a promise a spec or production code does not wait for, fix that instead.

If the environment has no git 2.56 or newer, install one outside the repository. If that is not possible, stop and say so rather than fixing an unproven cause.

## Don't undo these

- Do not retry or swallow the failed deletion (`maxRetries`, `catch`, a delay): it would hide a process that outlives its test.
- Do not retry tests, skip these two or make the integration job optional for a release.
- Keep the git configuration isolation.
- Do not change git maintenance in the operator's repository: production code leaves it as configured.
- Every agent call runs only inside the sandbox.

## How to work

From the repository root, with the Node version pinned in `package.json`:

```sh
npx vitest run --project integration src/adapters/git/git-workspace.integration.spec.ts
npm run test:integration
npm run validate
```

## Done when

- [ ] the commit message names the process or promise that wrote during deletion, and how it was observed
- [ ] 30 consecutive runs of the first command pass on git 2.56 or newer
- [ ] `git grep -n maxRetries tests vitest.workspace.ts` finds nothing
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` and `npm run validate` pass

Publication from `main` is checked after the merge, on the tracking issue.


Source: https://github.com/ygrishajev/jig/issues/84

context.repoSummary: Integration specs run in the Vitest integration project in vitest.workspace.ts, whose shared env already isolates Git with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1. tests/support/temp-directory.ts registers onTestFinished cleanup using recursive, forced rm without retries. temp-repo.ts creates real repositories; run-worktree.ts and open-run-worktree.ts add a host worktree and a clone representing the sandbox. The two affected git-workspace.integration.spec.ts cases amend commits and call GitWorkspace.saveWork(), which commits sandbox changes and imports a bundle through a host git fetch before checking approved ancestry. Git operations use simple-git and execa; no maintenance override currently exists in the inspected setup. Background maintenance remains unproven: implementation must first reproduce or trace the surviving writer with GIT_TRACE2_EVENT on Git >=2.56, then fix the demonstrated cause centrally in integration configuration if appropriate, preserving production Git behavior and strict cleanup. Current environment has Git 2.39.5 and Node 22.23.4; package.json pins Node 26.13.0 through Volta, so implementation needs suitable tooling, installing newer Git outside the repository. AGENTS.md and testing conventions require real-Git integration coverage, setup helpers, and no tests of static configuration. Acceptance requires 30 consecutive targeted runs, no maxRetries in tests or vitest.workspace.ts, full integration and validation success, and a commit message identifying the writer and observation method. scripts/validate.ts includes integration tests after other checks; .github/workflows/publish.yml gates publishing on integration success. No files were changed or failure cause verified during this context-building step.

plan.summary: Identify and stop the process or unawaited work that writes to temporary Git repositories during integration-test cleanup, preserving strict deletion and production Git behavior.
plan.approach: Use package.json’s pinned Node version and Git >=2.56, installing tooling outside the repository as needed. If suitable Git cannot be installed, stop and report the blocker. Before changing behavior, reproduce the failure or collect GIT_TRACE2_EVENT evidence correlated with cleanup timing to identify the surviving writer; background maintenance remains a hypothesis. If confirmed, disable the demonstrated automatic maintenance mechanism through the integration project’s shared Git configuration environment in vitest.workspace.ts, retaining existing global/system configuration isolation. If evidence identifies an unawaited promise or another cause, fix its owning module instead. The proposed configuration fix matches existing ownership: Vitest owns integration-wide isolation, temporary-directory helpers own strict cleanup, and Git adapters preserve operator-configured behavior. A mismatch would arise from placing test-only maintenance policy in production adapters or masking lifecycle defects in cleanup; resolve any evidence-driven change of ownership before implementation. Use existing real-Git behavioral coverage rather than tests of static configuration. Require 30 consecutive successful targeted runs on Git >=2.56, then npm run test:integration and npm run validate; verify git grep -n maxRetries tests vitest.workspace.ts returns no matches. Do not add deletion retries, delays, swallowed errors, test retries, skips, or release-gate exceptions. Record the identified writer and observation method in the commit message. Publication verification remains a post-merge tracking-issue task.
affectedAreas: vitest.workspace.ts: conditional integration-wide Git configuration fix after confirming the cause.
src/adapters/git/git-workspace.integration.spec.ts: existing amended-commit cases, diagnostic tracing, and 30 consecutive targeted validation runs.
tests/support/temp-directory.ts: cleanup timing observation during diagnosis; preserve recursive forced removal without retries or error suppression.
tests/support/temp-repo.ts, tests/support/run-worktree.ts, and tests/support/open-run-worktree.ts: inspect repository and subprocess lifetimes during diagnosis.
src/adapters/git/: inspect saveWork and underlying Git operations; change production code only if evidence demonstrates an owned lifecycle defect.
Commit message and validation evidence: document the actual writer, observation method, tooling versions, and required successful checks.
